stories.title: Man dies after being shot by Johnston police officer, Iowa DCI investigating
stories.summary: None of the officers involved were injured during the shooting.

stories.title: City of Urbandale approves Islamic and Educational Center Ezan expansion, met with community hate, backlash
stories.summary: Urbandale City Council member responds to negative community reaction to the approval of Islamic and Educational Center Ezan expansion.

stories.title: Baby boy declared Safe Haven, first to be relinquished through Iowa adoption service provider
stories.summary: A baby boy born on Oct. 19 has been declared a Safe Haven baby after he was safely relinquished to an approved Safe Haven adoption service provider.

stories.title: Marshalltown firefighters respond to 2 separate kitchen fire over weekend
stories.summary: Unrelated fires on Friday night and Sunday night damaged two Marshalltown homes, the fire department said.

stories.title: Rise in Iowa cancer incidence driven by better screening, new study suggests
stories.summary: The American Cancer Society-led study shows that more prostate and breast cancers were detected early in the decade leading up to 2022.

stories.title: 1 dead following pedestrian, vehicle crash in Poweshiek County
stories.summary: A man is dead after allegedly being hit by a vehicle traveling on I-80 in Poweshiek County on Saturday evening.

stories.title: Iowa Department of Education receives $250K grant to expand opportunities for adult learners
stories.summary: The Strategic Impact and Innovation Grant will help develop a new Prior Learning Assessment system for adult learners.

stories.title: 2 dead after Pocahontas house fire Friday afternoon
stories.summary: A 65-year-old woman and 3-year-old child were pronounced dead.

stories.title: Ankeny police located missing teen
stories.summary: A 15-year-old was reported missing at approximately 4 p.m. on November 12, the Ankeny Police Department said.

stories.title: Des Moines International Airport resumes flights after FAA lifts ground stop order
stories.summary: DSM is urging travelers to check their flight status with their airline before heading to the airport.

stories.title: Iowa measles cases rise as vaccination rates dip
stories.summary: The state medical director says measles is more than just a rash and can be deadly.

stories.title: 43 states, including Iowa, reach $183.5M settlement with Acima over rent-to-own practices
stories.summary: A group of 43 states reached a $183.5 million settlement with a rent-to-own finance company, with some consumers now eligible for refunds and debt relief.
